title: A weak hidden parameter can be irrelevant to the useful response
statement: For the introduced grounded tree Z0=[[3,2,1],[2,3,1],[1,1,2]], c=(1,0,-1),v=Z0c and chord resistance rho, Zrho=Z0-vv^T/(rho+3). Omitting the weak chord has all-current energy-relative error exactly3/rho against actual Zrho, absolute operator error6/(rho+3), and derivative norm6/(rho+3)^2. Supplied rho>=3/epsilon permits this response quotient; it does not acquire an unknown rho or physically remove a connection.
